answers: can I link GitHub issues in click docstrings
how to document rationale for a code choice in click
note.body:
Maintainer review on src/click/_termui_impl.py rejected docstrings in pager/_pipepager/edit_files that described PR/issue history, contained GitHub URLs, and covered internals users don't need.
Convention: don't put GitHub links in docs or code comments. Put a short explanation right above the relevant line instead, e.g. "split doesn't use posix mode because ...".
Issue/PR references go in CHANGES.rst entries using the `:issue:` and `:pr:` roles.
note.applies: comments and docstrings across src/click (maintainer review preference)
